lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Chapter title. Leave a clean beat before story begins.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: They started marking the shifted streets on the fifth day.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: It wasn't Ninsun's idea, though she was the one who made it permanent. After the second uncrossed name and a third alley that closed behind them before they finished measuring it, BAH-lahg simply said,

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: I'm tired of walking into the same fucking hole twice,

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: They used chalk at first. White marks on the older brick where a passage had opened. Simple. Visible. Temporary.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: By the second afternoon the chalk marks were gone.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Not washed off. Not worn away. Simply absent, as if the wall had never accepted them.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: En-HEH-doo crouched where the latest mark should have been and ran her thumb across the brick.
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: Or deciding the chalk doesn't belong,

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun said. She was already pulling a thin bronze stylus and a scrap of harder stone from her satchel.
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: We need something it can't ignore as easily.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek watched her cut a small, precise notch at the base of the wall, low enough that most people would miss it, deep enough that weather alone wouldn't erase it in a day. The sound of the stylus on brick was sharp and final.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg tested the notch with his boot.
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: They kept the system simple after that. One notch for a passage that had opened and closed. Two notches if it had shown names or objects worth remembering.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Three if it had tried to keep them. No one wrote explanations. Explanations were for people who expected the walls to stay still long enough to read them.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: On the sixth day they found a passage that already carried two notches they didn't remember cutting.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: No one spoke for a while.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: En-HEH-doo was the first to break the silence.
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: Either we're forgetting our own marks, or someone else is using the same system.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: I hate every version of that sentence.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek ran his fingers over the two clean notches. The edges were sharp. Recent. The same depth and angle Ninsun used. He looked at her. She shook her head once. Not hers.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: En-HEH-doo lowered it until the flame threw the notches into sharp relief. Ninsun took the bronze stylus from her satchel and held its tip against the first cut without touching the brick.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A small chip marred one edge of its point. Zeek had noticed it the day before when she marked the passage with the basin. The flaw left a narrow ridge in every cut she made, faint enough to miss unless the light struck from the side.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A thin line appeared inside the first notch.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: How many of those are there?

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: My sister gave it to me.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun pressed her thumb against the chipped edge.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: I have carried it for six years.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: So either you cut those and forgot—

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: It has not left my satchel.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: In this city, I'm no longer certain that matters.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: No footprints marked the dust inside the passage. No disturbed grit. No scrape where someone had braced a hand against the wall to make the cuts.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He looked at the second notch.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The lower end curved slightly to the left.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun always did that when cutting downward. Her wrist turned inward near the end of the stroke.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He had watched her make the same mistake eleven times.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: I didn't say you remember making them.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The passage breathed cold air over them.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Somewhere inside, stone clicked against stone.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg lowered his spear toward the opening.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: I liked you better before you started saying things like that.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A shape moved at the far end of the passage.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Close enough that all four of them saw it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: It stood with one arm raised against the wall.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A small sharp sound reached them.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun's hand closed around her stylus.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek kept watching the place where it had stood.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: We could also drink poison and save ourselves the walk.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: En-HEH-doo studied the two marks beside them.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: If that was one of us, entering may be what causes it.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: And walking away may be what causes it,

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The mark beneath Zeek's linen remained warm.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He thought of the chamber that had learned Ninsun's name. The black water bending toward his father's journal. The city producing evidence faster than they could understand it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: No. The third one is for a passage that knows us.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She placed the stylus against the brick.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: For the first time since he had met her, her hand trembled.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The cut came out straight anyway.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: They did not enter that passage.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: They cut a third notch beside the two, deeper than the others, and walked away.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: That night, back in the cheap room they were using as a base, Ninsun spread her scraps of parchment on the floor and began transferring every notch location she could still remember onto a single sheet. The map was ugly, incomplete, and already out of date in places.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: You know it's going to change again the moment we trust it,

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: Because the alternative is letting the city be the only one writing anything down.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun shifted three scraps of parchment across the floor. Each held a rough section of street, copied at a different scale. None aligned cleanly with the others.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She placed a clay cup on one corner to keep the papers flat.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek entered and crouched beside her.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The room smelled of lamp smoke, old plaster, and the sour beer BAH-lahg had abandoned near the window. Ninsun had marked every shifted passage with a short black line. Beside each she had recorded the number of notches and the day it appeared.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: Today they moved back toward the flood channel.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: I think patterns are what people call confusion when they want it to feel temporary.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The shadows of the parchment edges shifted.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun saw it at the same moment.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She pulled another scrap beneath the first.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun noticed but did not look at it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She drew the final arc in charcoal.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The line curled inward toward a point near the center of the lower districts.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: That is not the same thing.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She placed the tip of her stylus at the spiral's center.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The floor beneath them gave a faint knock.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A second knock came from directly below the map.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: When she set it down again, a new mark had appeared at the center of the spiral.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek took the lamp from her and held it closer.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Neither of them had drawn it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Her eyes moved to his satchel.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: Because every time it tells me something, I do what it wants.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun looked back at the three wet marks.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The floor knocked a third time.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: From the room next door, BAH-lahg's voice came through the wall.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: Whatever you two are doing, stop agreeing with the building.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: En-HEH-doo added something too low to make out.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun slowly withdrew her hand from beneath Zeek's.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She took a clean sheet of parchment and laid it over the altered map.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: You just said the city might be writing through the map.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: That doesn't mean it gets to keep the only copy.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Outside, somewhere in the lower districts, another alley was probably opening while they slept. Or closing. Or deciding which names still deserved to remain uncrossed.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek left her to it and checked the linen on his left hand. The mark was warm. Not urgent. Just present.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He did not open the journal.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He had not opened it in four days.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The decision still felt small. He was starting to trust that about it.
